items.exampleEn: The quake was small, and nobody felt it.
items.exampleZh: 那次地震很小，沒有人感覺到。

items.exampleEn: Apes are close relatives of humans.
The river flows through miles of farmland.
Moss grows well in wet places.
items.exampleZh: 苔蘚在潮濕的地方長得很好。

items.exampleEn: A swarm of flies covered the old fruit.
items.exampleZh: 一大群蒼蠅聚在那些放太久的水果上。

items.exampleEn: Some kinds of tigers are now extinct.
items.exampleZh: 有些種類的老虎現在已經絕種了。

items.exampleEn: A gorilla can be very strong.

items.sentenceEn: Look! There's a crow on the roof.

items.audioEn: During the quake, we hid under the table until the shaking stopped.
items.audioZh: 地震時，我們躲在桌子底下，直到搖晃停止。
options: Ran out of the house quickly.

items.sentenceEn: Most of the land here is farmland.
items.sentenceZh: 這裡大部分的土地都是農地。
大猩猩以家族為單位生活。

items.stemEn: Some people grow ____ in small glass jars.
items.stemZh: 有些人在小玻璃罐裡種苔蘚。

items.stemEn: We must protect these animals, or they will become ____.
items.stemZh: 我們必須保護這些動物，否則牠們會絕種。

items.passageEn: Last weekend, I visited a zoo outside the city. On the way, we drove past miles of farmland. At the zoo, the first animal we saw was a big gorilla. It looked magnificent. A guide told us that gorillas and other apes are very smart. Near the ape house, there was a sign about extinct animals, like a kind of bird that disappeared a hundred years ago. Then we walked through a small forest. The trees were covered with moss, and a crow kept following us. Suddenly, a swarm of bees flew past us, and everyone ran! The guide also told us that the zoo was built to stay safe in a quake.
items.passageZh: 上週末，我去了城外的一座動物園。路上，我們開車經過一大片農地。在動物園裡，我們看到的第一隻動物是一隻大猩猩，看起來非常威風。導覽員告訴我們，大猩猩和其他猿類都很聰明。在猿館附近，有一塊介紹已絕種動物的牌子，例如一種一百年前就消失的鳥。接著我們走過一片小樹林。樹上長滿了苔蘚，還有一隻烏鴉一直跟著我們。突然，一大群蜜蜂從我們身邊飛過，大家都拔腿就跑！導覽員還告訴我們，這座動物園蓋得能在地震時保持安全。

questions.questionZh: 去動物園的路上經過什麼？
為什麼大家突然跑了起來？
options: 一隻大猩猩從籠子跑了出來
一大群蜜蜂從身邊飛過

items.promptZh: 這種植物在一百年前就絕種了。
referenceEn: This plant became extinct a hundred years ago.
This kind of plant became extinct one hundred years ago.
rubricZh: extinct 表示「絕種的」，例如 become extinct 等說法
時態配合內容（例如說過去的事用過去式等）

items.instructionZh: 用 crow 造一個句子，說說你看過的烏鴉。
referenceEn: I often see crows in the park near my house.
A crow once took food from my hand.
rubricZh: crow 表示「烏鴉」，例如 a black crow 等說法
說的是自己的經驗（例如 I、my）
時態配合內容（例如現在簡單式或過去式等）
